“samagrasya tu sEnyasya vinyAsaH sTAnaBedataH । sa vyUha iti viKyAto yudDezu pfTivIBujAm ॥ vyUhaBedAstu catvAro daRqo Bogo'stramaRqalam । asaMhataSca nirRItA nItisArAdisammatAH ॥ anye'pi prakftivyUhAH Bavet ॥ yudDArTaM yudDakuSalaM caRqAnIkaM prayojayet । yudDaM hi nAyakaprARaM hanyate tadanAyakam ॥ vyUho'nupfzWamacalaH pattyaSvaraTadantiBiH । taTApratihato jYeyo hastyaSvaraTapattiBiH ॥ maDye deSe hayAnIkaM raTAnIkaM tu kakzayoH । pakzayoSca gajAnIkaM vyUho'ntaBidayaM smftaH ॥ raTasTAne hayAndadyAtpadAtIMSca hayASraye । raTABAve tu matimAnnAgAneva prakalpayet ॥ viBajya prakzipenmaDye syAdBogatvAdvfttireva ca । pradaro dfQako'sahyaScApo vE tadbiparyyayaH ॥ pratizWaH supratizWaSca SyenI vijayasaYjayO । viSAlavijayaH sUcI sTaRAkarRaScamUmuKaH ॥ suKAKyo valayaScEva daRqaBedAH SatrusenAviBedakam । vyUharacanasaNketAn vAdyaBAzAsamIritAn । svasEnikErvinA ko'pi na jaHnIyAt taTAviDAn । niyojayecca matimAn vyUhAn nAnAviDAn sadA । aSvAnAYca gajAnAYca padAtInAM pfTak pfTak । uccEH yAnaM prayARamapayAnakam । paryyAyeRa ca sAmmuKyaM samutTAnaYca luRWanam । saMsTAnaM cAzwadalacaccakravadgolatulyakam । sUcotulyaM SakawavadardDacandrasamantu vA । pfTagBavanamalpAlpEH paryyAyEH orderly arrangement of the parts of a whole (cf. चरण-व्य्˚), disposition, Nyāyas.

military array, an army, host, squadron (various arrays are दण्ड-, ‘staff-like array’; शकट-, ‘cart array’; वराह-, ‘boar array’; मण्डल-, ‘circular ar˚’; अ-संहत-, ‘loose ar˚’; आखेट-व्यूह, ‘hunting array’ &c.), Mn. vii, 187; MBh. &c.

a section, division, chapter, Sarvad.

form, manifestation (esp. the quadruple manifestation of Puruṣottama as Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha), appearance (often ifc. after numerals, cf. चतुर्-, त्रिर्-व्य्˚), MBh.; BhP.; Sarvad.

an aggregate, flock, multitude, Vās.; Śatr.
the body, W.
breathing, Nyāyas.

a: व्यूहः — 1 A military array; Ms. 7. 187. --2 An army, a host, squadron; व्यूहावुभौ तावितरेतरस्मात् भंगं जयं चापतुरव्यवस्थं R. 7. 54. --3 A large quantity, an assemblage, a multitude, collection. --4 A part, portion, subhead. --5 The body. --6 Structure, formation. --7 Reasoning, logic. --8 Separation, distribution. --9 (In phil.)
